sip.plan_summary: 1. After #120 acceptance, bind one FastWork issue worktree and create child goal naming ADL #1299 and security #9. 2. Verify RD-09 provenance and supported interface identities. 3. Map every principal/resource boundary and invariant to current enforcement and positive/adverse cases. 4. Implement minimal adapter-side changes only where contract requires. 5. Run focused source and installed proof; retain counts/failures and independent exact-head review. Stop on missing Runtime primitive, changed interface, unsupported consumer, unapproved resources or ambiguous ownership.
sip.required_outcome_inline: Define and enforce CodeFriend principal, tenant, repository, service and paired-agent trust boundaries against supported Runtime interfaces; identify any missing primitive as a bounded prerequisite.
sip.deliverables_inline: Produce CodeFriend consumer trust-boundary contract and enforcement mapping for principal, tenant, repository, service and paired agent; inventory supported versioned Runtime interface; implement only necessary adapter-side restrictions and focused negative cases in src/, tests/, conformance/ and contract documentation. Missing Runtime primitive becomes a bounded prerequisite rather than a Runtime-v4 expansion.
sip.acceptance_criteria_inline: Exact consumer/runtime/interface identities and actual scenario counts are retained. Explicitly verify least privilege, per-message checks, revocation, secret redaction, audit integrity, tenant isolation, deletion and fail-closed consumer behavior. Exercise implicit internal trust and connection-as-permission rejection. Runtime retains final enforcement; adapter restrictions cannot add grants. Document missing primitives and refuse unsupported acceptance; independent review resolves actionable findings.
sip.dependencies_inline: Accepted CodeFriend #120 corpus, identities and acceptance denominator; accepted v0.93.1 RD-09 contract evidence; authenticated Runtime interface archive/version/digest and supported consumer inputs. These are execution gates; #120 remains OPEN and its output does not yet exist.

Run only after artifact admission; resource profile bounded CPU/subprocess on Linux x86_64 matching the retained authenticated artifact; no paid provider/cloud calls.
